name: Baba Yaga

crownPassive.text: Must start in slot 1 and always holds the Crown, which travels with her. If the Crown ever passes to another of your heroes, you lose.
crownPassive.name: Mistress of the hut

bond.name: Hut on hen's legs
bond.text: Your other heroes have -1 Speed (never below 1) and -2 Health. This bond doesn't affect the enemy.

actions.name: Skull fire
actions.text: Ranged attack for 3 on any card.

actions.name: Mortar ride
actions.text: Move to any adjacent space, on either side of the board, killing whatever is there. Gains 2 Health if she kills something, even above her starting Health. Can't move onto the enemy Crown's space.

rules: Starts on 25 health with no maximum; only kills raise it past 25.
Against Robin's No Crown she still can't move onto slot 1.
Her Mortar ride kills whatever is in the space she moves into, on either side, so it can kill your own heroes in her path.
